title: Who files the flood
subtitle: Monthly CVE volume by filer and filer type since 2020, and the filers behind the growth

plan.title: Who files the flood
plan.estimator: monthly share by filer and filer type; filers behind the growth
plan.prediction: a few filers account for most of the growth
plan.interval: cluster bootstrap by filer, 2000 resamples, 95 percent

window: every window; growth from 2020 to the twelve months 2025-11-01 to 2026-11-01 (end excluded)
interval: cluster bootstrap by filer, 2000 resamples, 95 percent

rejected.population: CVEs published since 2020-01-01 and since rejected

net_growth.population: the change from 2020 to the last twelve months

top10_share_of_growth.unit: share of the net growth carried by the ten filers with the largest increases

filers_for_half_of_growth.unit: the fewest filers whose increases together pass half of the net growth

monthly_by_filer_type.population: CVEs published each month since 2020-01, by the type of their filer

growth_by_filer.population: the twenty filers with the largest increase from 2020 to the last twelve months

prediction_check: The ten filers with the largest increases carry 0.7671475947477269 of the net growth; 5.0 filers carry half of it.
method: Volume counts every CVE published in a month, rejected ones included as the plan states (their number is given). Growth compares calendar 2020 with the last twelve complete months before the data cut; each filer's part is its own change. The top ten share and the number of filers that carry half of the net growth are recomputed in each of 2,000 cluster bootstrap replicates over filers, 95 percent intervals.
sql:
-- Q6: CVEs published since 2020 by month and filer type, with each type's share of the month.
select
    published_month,
    filer_type,
    sum(cves) as cves,
    sum(cves) / any_value(month_total) as share_of_month
from gold.mart_backlog_q6
group by published_month, filer_type
order by published_month, filer_type
